title: Columbus and Other Heroes of American Discovery
summary: "Columbus and Other Heroes of American Discovery" by N. D'Anvers is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The opening of the work sets the stage for a comprehensive discussion on prior voyages to America, suggesting that Columbus may not have been the first to discover the New World. The text hints at a broader scope of exploration leading up to Columbus, emphasizing the contributions of various travelers and underscoring the complex interplay between discovery and conquest that characterized this pivotal historical period.
